mapper.select: select c.course_id courseId, c.course_name courseName, ta1.lat attraction1Lat, ta1.lon attraction1Lon, ta1.name attraction1Name, ta2.lat attraction2Lat, ta2.lon attraction2Lon, ta2.name attraction2Name, ta3.lat attraction3Lat, ta3.lon attraction3Lon, ta3.name attraction3Name from course c join tourist_attraction ta1 on c.attraction_id1 = ta1.id join tourist_attraction ta2 on c.attraction_id2 = ta2.id join tourist_attraction ta3 on c.attraction_id3 = ta3.id where c.attraction_id1 = #{id} or c.attraction_id2 = #{id} or c.attraction_id3 = #{id}
